description: cloud/indexes/storage-modes.md's filename and title imply a choice of storage modes (mirroring server/'s Standard vs. Memory-Optimized, an Enterprise-Edition-gated choice), but the Capella page's actual content states flatly there is only one storage engine (Plasma) with no choice to make. The page structure was carried over from server/ without adapting to the fact that the underlying distinction doesn't exist on Capella.
